note: Pickens County AL publishes parcels only through a Flagship-hosted public GIS viewer (alabamagis.com/pickens). No public ArcGIS REST, WFS or bulk download for parcels was found. The NSGIC portal lists the viewer as the parcel access point. The Alabama_Parcel_Data hosted service (services6.arcgis.com/VUsVQlvugJlIRS3I) has no Pickens parcel layer in its listing. Regrid Pickens data is a paid purchase, with only sample CSVs free.
